Experienced across Product Development, Retail Banking, and Trade Finance operations, with strong expertise in requirement gathering, BRD, FRD, RTM, use cases, user stories, and test cases. Proficient in stakeholder management and delivery using both Agile and Waterfall methodologies with tools like Jira and Confluence. Seeking Senior Business Analyst or Product Owner opportunities in IT, Banking, or Fintech organizations to drive business value through deep domain knowledge and strong delivery capabilities, along with strategic leadership roles to drive innovation, regulatory excellence, and operational efficiency across BFSI.
Senior Business Analyst with overall 18+ years of extensive experience in the BFSI domain, specializing in end-to-end business analysis, process re-engineering, and strategic solution delivery across Agile and Waterfall SDLC models. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional technical teams across design, development, and testing to drive seamless project execution.
Expert in requirements elicitation, stakeholder workshops, gap/impact analysis, and translating complex business needs into precise BRDs, FSDs, User Stories, Use Cases.
Strong analytical capability with a proven track record of identifying root causes, optimizing processes, and recommending data-driven, scalable solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
Highly experienced in “As-Is” and “To-Be” process mapping, Business process modeling, workflow design, and developing standardized business processes.
Skilled in defining test strategies, reviewing test cases, and leading UAT cycles—including defect tracking, validation, and coordinating feedback with business users to ensure solution accuracy and compliance.
Recognized for effectively bridging the gap between business and technology teams, driving cross-functional collaboration, and managing stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
Possesses domain expertise in business processes of Retail Banking digital platforms like Net Banking, Mobile Banking across the modules like Accounts, Deposits, Cards, Loans, Payments, Wealth Management with a strong understanding of compliance, and risk mitigation practices. Worked in Trade Finance & aware of its products like Import, Export transactions, Bank Guarantee, Letter of Credit along with business processes.
Proficient in writing detailed User Stories in Jira, maintaining comprehensive project documentation in Confluence, and ensuring version control and traceability throughout the delivery lifecycle.

responsibilities: Senior Business Analyst in Business Solutions Group (BSG) for Digital Transformation Projects in Net Banking, Mobile Banking – Implementation of new features & change requests (CR’s) across the modules like Account Servicing, Deposit Servicing, Cards & Loans Servicing, Payments, Wealth Management User Journeys – STP.
Trade Finance - Implementation of Change Requests in Internal Application for trade transactions.

Acted as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring seamless translation of business requirements into clear technical specifications and validating that developers and QA teams fully understood the documented requirements.

Analyzed existing Mobile Banking and Net Banking processes to identify gaps, streamline workflows, and drive process optimization, automation opportunities, and application re-engineering initiatives.
Owned requirement elicitation, documentation, review, and obtaining formal sign-off prior to implementation; coordinated with design, development, QA teams to enable successful feature delivery.

Conducted detailed requirement-gathering sessions through interviews, workshops, and surveys; prepared comprehensive BRDs, Use Cases, and detailed User Stories with clear acceptance criteria in BDD format.
Worked closely with Product Managers, SMEs, and end users to refine business needs and convert them into well-defined, development-ready user stories aligned with business objectives.
Performed GAP analysis and created detailed AS-IS and TO-BE process flow diagrams, providing stakeholders with clear visibility on system behavior and proposed improvements for decision-making.

Actively participated in Scrum ceremonies - Sprint Planning, Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives—to support sprint planning, requirement grooming, and iterative delivery with continuous improvements.
Supported testing teams by clarifying requirements, reviewing functional test cases, and ensuring comprehensive coverage across all business scenarios.

Led and coordinated User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating functionalities, tracking defects, capturing business feedback, and ensuring compliance with approved requirements before production release.
Handled production issues and defect analysis, managing bugs, prioritizing fixes, and supporting delivery of both new enhancements and production support requirements.

Senior Business Analyst - Digital Banking Transformation Projects on Web & Mobile applications for Customer Onboarding for Retail Savings Accounts & Credit Cards. Implementation of Servicing features for Retail Loans & Credit Cards on Net Banking & Mobile Applications.

Conducted comprehensive requirement gathering from business users, product owners, and compliance teams to capture business needs and translate them into detailed BRDs, FRDs, and Change Requests (CRs).

Acted as a key liaison between business and technical teams, facilitating requirement walkthroughs, review meetings, and sign-off sessions to ensure shared understanding of project scope and functionality.

Collaborated closely with Product teams to define, prioritize user stories in the product backlog; led backlog grooming sessions and coordinated with technical teams to refine stories and align sprint priorities.
Supported QA teams by reviewing test cases, clarifying requirements, and ensuring full coverage of business scenarios; coordinated and led User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with end users.
Reported project progress and upcoming releases to management in a timely manner and conducted functional demos for business users during release cycles.

Collected and tracked post-release feedback from business teams, monitored newly deployed features, and ensured clear communication among stakeholders to prevent scope creep and maintain project alignment.

Business Analyst – Business Technology Group (BTG) – Enhancements on Mobile Application in multiple areas like Account Servicing, Deposits, Cards, Payments, Wealth Management. Origination of Credit Cards & Retail Loans for Pre-approved Customer base (STP Journeys) on Web & Mobile Channels.
Wealth Management – Mutual Funds A/c opening (ISA A/c Opening) on Web Channel (Net Banking) & Implementation of features – Financial transactions (SIP, Lumpsum, STP, SWP, Redeem, Switch etc.)
Delivered key enhancements and new features on Mobile Banking, and Web Channels for different areas.
Elicited, analyzed, and translated business requirements into detailed User Stories and Product Backlog Items (PBIs) using Jira, ensuring complete clarity for development and QA teams.
Prepared and managed Change Requests (CRs) for functional enhancements, coordinated approvals, and secured formal requirement sign-offs from business stakeholders.
Performed end-to-end Business Process Analysis, identified process gaps, and recommended improvements, automation opportunities, and re-engineering actions to enhance operational efficiency.
Conducted GAP analysis and documented AS-IS and TO-BE workflows using process flow diagrams to provide clear functional visibility for stakeholders and technical teams.
Collaborated closely with Business, UX Design, Development, and QA teams to refine requirements, validate prototypes, and ensure accurate implementation aligned with business expectations.

Developed comprehensive business documentation including BRDs, FRDs, CRs, process flows, user guides, and other functional artefacts for seamless project delivery. Provided Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions to Design, Development, QA teams to ensure alignment on business requirements and functional workflows.
Led and coordinated User Acceptance Testing (UAT)—reviewing test cases, validating functionalities, capturing user feedback, and securing business sign-off before production releases.
Conducted feature demos for Business and Product Management teams, ensuring alignment of delivered functionalities with scope and expectations.
Monitored and managed defects/bugs, coordinated with development and QA teams for timely resolution, and provided support for both new feature delivery and production issues.

Reported project status, risks, dependencies, timelines to seniors at regular intervals. Managed stakeholder expectations, resolved conflicts, identified project risks, dependencies throughout the SDLC lifecycle.

Career Objective
Seasoned Senior Business Analyst with 8+ years of experience in the BFSI domain, specializing in Retail Banking digital platforms such as Net Banking, Mobile Banking, and Trade Finance, along with enterprise digital transformation initiatives. Experienced across Product Development, Retail Banking, and Trade Finance operations, with strong expertise in requirement gathering, BRD, FRD, RTM, use cases, user stories, and test cases. Proficient in stakeholder management and delivery using both Agile and Waterfall methodologies with tools like Jira and Confluence. Seeking Senior Business Analyst or Product Owner opportunities in IT, Banking, or Fintech organizations to drive business value through deep domain knowledge and strong delivery capabilities, along with strategic leadership roles to drive innovation, regulatory excellence, and operational efficiency across BFSI.
Professional Summary
Senior Business Analyst with overall 18+ years of extensive experience in the BFSI domain, specializing in end-to-end business analysis, process re-engineering, and strategic solution delivery across Agile and Waterfall SDLC models. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional technical teams across design, development, and testing to drive seamless project execution.
Expert in requirements elicitation, stakeholder workshops, gap/impact analysis, and translating complex business needs into precise BRDs, FSDs, User Stories, Use Cases.
Strong analytical capability with a proven track record of identifying root causes, optimizing processes, and recommending data-driven, scalable solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
Highly experienced in “As-Is” and “To-Be” process mapping, Business process modeling, workflow design, and developing standardized business processes.
Skilled in defining test strategies, reviewing test cases, and leading UAT cycles—including defect tracking, validation, and coordinating feedback with business users to ensure solution accuracy and compliance.
Recognized for effectively bridging the gap between business and technology teams, driving cross-functional collaboration, and managing stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
Possesses domain expertise in business processes of Retail Banking digital platforms like Net Banking, Mobile Banking across the modules like Accounts, Deposits, Cards, Loans, Payments, Wealth Management with a strong understanding of compliance, and risk mitigation practices. Worked in Trade Finance & aware of its products like Import, Export transactions, Bank Guarantee, Letter of Credit along with business processes.
Proficient in writing detailed User Stories in Jira, maintaining comprehensive project documentation in Confluence, and ensuring version control and traceability throughout the delivery lifecycle.
